features.feature_value: Evaluated whether the pair supported respectful debate and whether claims were factually correct.
features.evidence_span: promote a healthy atmosphere for actual debate
features.rationale: The reflection explicitly ties influence to debate tone and factual correctness.

features.feature_value: Negative reaction to the right-wing version as being “dumb,” while also viewing it as correctly characterized.
features.evidence_span: painful reading any of the right-wing ones because of how dumb and correctly-characterized they were.
features.rationale: They describe a strong affective response to right-wing content along with an assessment of characterization.

features.feature_value: Saw political disagreement as highly polarized and often not clearly articulated with facts; some people “spout off whatever comes to mind.”
features.evidence_span: people dont necessarily articulate their differences clearly from either side backed with facts.
features.rationale: Their justification focuses on clarity of differences and factual grounding.

features.feature_value: Used message tone to judge whether statements felt “more wrong” or incorrect; also accepted opposing viewpoints as “fine.”
features.evidence_span: What influenced me was the tone of the messages.
features.rationale: They attribute influence primarily to tone and then discuss correctness/acceptability of opposite views.

features.feature_value: Would not remove/disallow content if it was not violent, despite disagreeing with it.
features.evidence_span: They were not violent so I wouldn't disallow them on my forum.
features.rationale: They state a clear criterion (no violence) for disallowing decisions.

features.feature_value: Attempted to be impartial and look for positive and negative sides of each party.
features.evidence_span: tried to be as impartial as possible
features.rationale: They describe a deliberate balancing approach across the political pair/parties.

features.feature_value: Mainly influenced by the language used.
features.evidence_span: Mainly the language that was used
features.rationale: They directly credit language choice as the principal driver of their decision.

features.feature_value: Based decisions on “blatant misinformation” and whether content could invite violence; allowed expressing opinions for free speech.
features.evidence_span: blatant misinformation or could invite violence
features.rationale: They specify the governing decision rules and note a free-speech rationale when only opinions were expressed.
